settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only Admins and the Captain can change these settings.
settings.archiveHint: Read-only for everyone; pending invitations are cancelled.

settings.unarchiveHint: Editing comes back; cancelled invitations stay cancelled.
settings.leaveHint: You lose access; only a Captain or an Admin can bring you back.
settings.deleteHint: Irreversible: its challenges, writeups and files go with it.
settings.deleteText: Everything in it is deleted for good.
settings.leaveDescription: You will lose access to this workspace and all its content. This action cannot be undone.
settings.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this workspace?

identity.title: Identity
identity.slugHint: Set at creation; links to the workspace use it.
